## Installation

1. Download and install [Max Payne 3 Fusion Fix](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/MaxPayne3.FusionFix#readme), or the required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
2. Download [Xbox Rain Droplets for Max Payne 3](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/XboxRainDroplets/releases/download/maxpayne3/MaxPayne3.XboxRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` and `.ini` files into the `plugins` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

## Notes

- The ini is watched while the game runs, so its settings can be changed and tested without restarting.
